questions.q: Rheumatic pains that are worse before a thunderstorm are a keynote of:
questions.why: Rhododendron: dread of storms, with pains that come on before a thunderstorm and ease once it breaks.

questions.q: Thrombocytopenia is a common laboratory finding in:
questions.why: The platelet count is monitored in dengue.

questions.q: Among the mental generals, Kent placed first the symptoms of:
The HPI standard for a homoeopathic drug lays down its:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Pharmacopoeial monographs fix identity, purity and strength.

questions.q: 'Clarke's Clinical Repertory' (1904) is an example of a:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Rubrics are named after clinical conditions.

questions.q: A fixed pain under the inferior angle of the right scapula, with liver complaints and jaundice, calls for the organ remedy:
questions.why: Chelidonium: constant pain under the lower inner angle of the right scapula is its keynote; it is a leading liver remedy.

questions.q: Skin eruptions with deep, bleeding cracks that are worse in winter, together with seasickness, point to:
questions.why: Petroleum: deep fissures and cracks worse in winter; nausea from riding in carriages and ships (Boericke).

questions.q: The first carpometacarpal joint of the thumb is an example of a:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. The saddle joint allows opposition of the thumb.

questions.q: Wild, uncontrollable laughter alternating with weeping, inappropriate jealousy and suspicion, and a dislike of tight clothing around the neck, indicate:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Lachesis: loquacity, left side, cannot bear constriction.

questions.q: The specific antidote for paracetamol overdose is:
questions.why: N-acetylcysteine replenishes glutathione and prevents liver necrosis.
